description: This file defines the SNHistoryManager class responsible for managing session and remote history of notes, including tracking changes, optimizing history entries, and observing item changes within the application.

classes.name: SNHistoryManager
classes.description: A class that manages history entries for notes, including session history, remote history, and history optimization.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up references and removes observers when the instance is deinitialized.

methods.name: recordNewHistoryForItems
methods.description: Records new history entries for a list of note items, updating history map and staging, and triggering optimization.

methods.name: sessionHistoryForItem
methods.description: Returns the session history entries for a specific note.

methods.name: getHistoryMapCopy
methods.description: Returns a frozen copy of the current history map.

methods.name: optimizeHistoryForItem
methods.description: Removes or retains history entries based on significance, age, and thresholds to optimize storage.
